## ✨ Added

- **Sign-in through your own login provider.** The new advanced fields **Login provider URL**, **Login client ID** and **Login role claim** connect OpenCloud to Authentik, Keycloak, Pocket ID or another OpenID Connect provider, without editing `proxy.yaml` or `csp.yaml`. Accounts are created at the first sign-in, and roles can come from the provider too. The [guide](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/opencloud/blob/main/docs/guide.md#sign-in-through-your-own-login-provider-optional) lists what to set up at the provider. Thanks to @montydepaola ([#123](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/opencloud/issues/123)) for the idea.
- **Provider accounts are matched by the provider's fixed ID.** OpenCloud ties each sign-in to the provider's `sub` ID, so accounts from the provider and local accounts such as `admin` stay separate. From OpenCloud 8.1, which `rolling` runs, it also checks that each access token was issued to OpenCloud's own client. If you already set `OC_OIDC_ISSUER` by hand, accounts matched by username start fresh unless you set `PROXY_USER_OIDC_CLAIM=preferred_username`, and Keycloak needs an Audience mapper on the client, as the guide explains.
- **Your own Content-Security-Policy lines survive a restart.** Put them into `csp.local.yaml` next to `csp.yaml` in the Config folder, and at every start the container merges them with what the web office and the login provider need, without duplicates.

## ⚡ Improved

- Updated dependencies: Vite 8.3.8 and the OpenCloud TypeScript config 8.2.2 for the branding app, and newer digests for the Go and Node.js build images.
- Every build boots the image with a stand-in for the server and checks the variables and the `csp.yaml` the entrypoint hands over.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Go 1.27.4 for the branding and search helpers.** Go 1.27.3 has a header race in its HTTP server that can crash the branding app (GO-2026-6859). Both helpers now build with the fixed release.
- **fast-xml-parser 5.12.0 for the branding app's build.** It clears the low-severity advisory in the tools that build the branding web extension.
